abstract: This article studies entry preemption in new industries. We first test a key prediction of dynamic entry games: Entry preemption is most relevant in intermediate‐sized markets, where firms face highest uncertainty about future entry. Using US drive‐in theater market (1945–1957) data, we find robust evidence for this non‐monotonic relationship between market size and early entry probability. We then estimate a dynamic entry game, and quantify preemption effects through counterfactual analysis. Preemptive motives increase early entry by up to 40% in mid‐size markets, raising entry costs by 5% and reducing firms' expected value by 1%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究新产业中的进入抢占行为。我们首先检验动态进入博弈的一个关键预测：进入抢占在中等规模市场中最为显著，因为此时企业面临最大的未来进入不确定性。利用美国汽车影院市场（1945-1957年）的数据，我们发现了市场规模与早期进入概率之间呈非单调关系的稳健证据。随后，我们估计了一个动态进入博弈模型，并通过反事实分析量化了抢占效应。在中等规模市场中，抢占动机使早期进入率最高增加40%，导致进入成本上升5%，并使企业预期价值降低1%。
title: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
title_zh: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场

abstract: We study the competition and welfare effects of upstream partial ownerships (UPO) in a framework with two competing supply chains and downstream firms choosing their product positionings strategically. We find that UPO reduces downstream product differentiation and thus intensifies downstream competition. Unlike the standard results of Bertrand competition, we find that downstream prices can be strategic substitutes even when downstream firms compete in Bertrand fashion. More importantly, we show that UPO increases consumer surplus and social welfare, even when double marginalization increases downstream prices. The competition and welfare results from downstream partial ownerships (DPO) are just the opposite to those from UPO. Our findings have clear managerial and policy implications.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了上游部分所有权（UPO）在两条竞争性供应链框架下的竞争与福利效应，其中下游企业战略性选择产品定位。研究发现，UPO会降低下游产品差异化程度，从而加剧下游竞争。与伯特兰竞争的标准结论不同，我们发现即使下游企业以伯特兰方式竞争，下游价格仍可能呈现战略替代性。更重要的是，我们证明即使双重边际化推高了下游价格，UPO仍能提升消费者剩余和社会福利。下游部分所有权（DPO）的竞争与福利效应则与UPO完全相反。本研究具有明确的管理与政策启示。

abstract: This paper generalizes the original Brander and Taylor model of open‐access renewable resource use and trade to address three common critiques. First, I introduce heterogeneity across agents in harvesting productivity to smooth out the model's extreme specialization patterns while maintaining its Ricardian structure and tractability. Second, I move beyond the original assumption of open access by constructing a policy stringency function allowing for partial, first‐best, and endogenous resource policy. Third, by exploiting the smooth substitution possibilities generated by agent heterogeneity and the insight that policy stringency functions are likely to vary across countries, I show how the model's core predictions can be evaluated using empirical methods related to those in growth econometrics.
abstract_zh: 本文对Brander和Taylor关于开放获取可再生资源利用与贸易的原始模型进行了推广，以回应三项常见批评。首先，我在采掘生产率方面引入主体异质性，在保持模型李嘉图结构与可处理性的同时，平滑了其极端专业化模式。其次，通过构建一个允许部分最优、第一最优及内生资源政策的政策严格度函数，我突破了原始模型对开放获取的假设。第三，利用主体异质性产生的平滑替代可能性以及政策严格度函数可能因国家而异的洞见，我展示了如何运用增长计量经济学相关的实证方法来评估模型的核心预测。
title: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux
title_zh: 自由贸易对可再生资源有益吗？布兰德与泰勒再探

abstract: This paper provides archival and survey evidence on retail investor use of Generative AI (GenAI). Our archival analysis examines over 400,000 investor queries to a major brokerage's GenAI chatbot. Investors most often use GenAI to help interpret and contextualize financial information and market movements, and for additional tasks including stock screening and streamlining complex research. As time with the tool grows, usage shifts from stock screening and high-level company assessments toward detailed monitoring and interpretation of firm news. Our survey of over 2,000 retail investors explores who adopts GenAI and why. Nearly half report using GenAI, primarily to accelerate and simplify information processing. More sophisticated retail investors lead adoption, deploying GenAI for more complex tasks and diverse information sources. Concerns about response quality and data privacy represent the biggest obstacles to further adoption. Heterogeneous adoption highlights the need for research into GenAI's impact on investor behavior and market dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于散户投资者使用生成式人工智能（GenAI）的档案与调查证据。我们的档案分析考察了超过40万条投资者向某大型券商GenAI聊天机器人提出的查询。投资者最常使用GenAI来帮助解读和情境化金融信息及市场动态，并执行包括股票筛选和简化复杂研究在内的其他任务。随着使用该工具时间的增长，使用行为从股票筛选和高层次公司评估转向对公司新闻的详细监控与解读。我们对超过2000名散户投资者的调查探讨了谁采用GenAI及其原因。近半数受访者表示使用GenAI，主要目的是加速和简化信息处理过程。更为成熟的散户投资者引领了采用趋势，他们将GenAI应用于更复杂的任务和多样化的信息来源。对回答质量和数据隐私的担忧是进一步采用的最大障碍。采用行为的异质性凸显了研究GenAI对投资者行为和市场动态影响的必要性。
title: Generative AI and investor processing of financial information
title_zh: 生成式人工智能与投资者对财务信息的处理

abstract: This study investigates whether auditors incorporate investor information demand when determining key audit matter (KAM) disclosures. We measure investor information demand using a unique dataset of investor inquiries submitted through investor interactive platforms (IIPs) established by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. At the topic level, we find that auditors are more likely to disclose a given topic as a KAM when investors raise more inquiries on that topic. At the aggregate level, a higher proportion of inquiries devoted to accounting issues is associated with both a greater number of KAMs and longer KAM disclosures. Importantly, following the introduction of KAM reporting, managers’ footnote disclosures become more aligned with heightened investor inquiries, reinforcing our interpretation that the documented effects reflect auditors’ responses to investor inquiries rather than merely mirroring managerial disclosure changes. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors incorporate investor information demand into KAM disclosures.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨审计师在确定关键审计事项（KAM）披露时，是否纳入投资者信息需求。我们利用中国证券监督管理委员会设立的投资者互动平台（IIPs）上提交的投资者问询独特数据集来衡量投资者信息需求。在主题层面，我们发现当投资者对某一主题提出更多问询时，审计师更有可能将该主题作为关键审计事项进行披露。在总体层面，涉及会计问题的问询比例越高，关键审计事项的数量越多，其披露内容也越长。重要的是，在关键审计事项报告引入后，管理层脚注披露与投资者问询的增加更加一致，这强化了我们的解释，即所记录的影响反映了审计师对投资者问询的回应，而非仅仅是对管理层披露变化的镜像反映。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师将投资者信息需求纳入关键审计事项披露中。

abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal councils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中，权力下放被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中是否有效的实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效导向有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据和地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效导向有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效导向有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可量化改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著提升，其中卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点、供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点、教育满意度提高1.0个百分点，同时市镇议会信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，总统和议会信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生显著回报。估算表明，假设信任向税收遵从的传导效应与文献参数基本一致，观察到的信任提升可能通过增强自愿纳税遵从带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍。这些发现与以下观点一致：设计良好的绩效导向转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效导向有条件拨款制度化纳入马里财政架构，并制定中期路线图以实现可持续发展和可能的规模扩展。
title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali
title_zh: 分权、服务提供与合法性：以马里为例

abstract: Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.
abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。

abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。

abstract: The legal recognition of Customary Forest (Hutan Adat) in Indonesia centres around a state-centric understanding of community land tenure. Often presented as a progressive policy, in its support of sedentary-agrarian communities and underlying plantation logic it is agrocentric in its paradigm. This research employs a critical ethnographic approach to analyse the struggles of a community in obtaining legal recognition, namely the last nomadic group of Kalimantan, the Punan Batu. Using an integrated SPA-Cube Framework, this study examines the ways that agrocentric governmentality works to marginalise the Punan, while providing formal state recognition. Indeed, we chart the ways Punan nomadic ontologies are rendered illegible. The analysis begins by examining the power background, revealing historical and structural inequalities rooted in state policies that systematically problematise nomadic ways of life. It then investigates the power delivery strategies of a non-governmental organization Yayasan Konservasi Alam Nusantara (YKAN) in their aims to leverage scientific research and participatory mapping to support recognition. While these tactics succeeded in securing district-level support, they also acted as government technologies to discipline the Punan Batu’s mobilities by redefining them into state-recognisable subjects, re-territorialising their fluid spatial practices and formalising egalitarian social structures and practices. Finally, the analysis explores processes of power adjustment, revealing that interventions provoke retaliation from timber companies and agrarian settlers, entrenching patron-client networks to generate momentum for internal dissent. The first author’s positionality as a YKAN insider enabled rich, three-year-long participatory observation, providing deep access and unique insights. These insider perspectives were tempered through the collaborative research approach and prioritised an overall critical reflexivity in engagement and analysis. Conceptually, this study contributes to environmental governance by demonstrating how the SPA-Cube Framework illuminates the paradoxes of recognition, where empowerment strategies can inadvertently reinforce the very governmental logics they challenge. Practically, it highlights the limitations of current recognition paradigms and offers critical insights for NGOs and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 印度尼西亚习惯森林（Hutan Adat）的法律承认，其核心在于以国家为中心理解社区土地权属。尽管该政策常被表述为进步性举措，但其在支持定居农耕社区及隐含的种植园逻辑方面，本质上属于农业中心主义范式。本研究采用批判性民族志方法，分析一个社区在争取法律承认过程中的抗争，该社区即加里曼丹最后的游牧群体——普南巴图（Punan Batu）。通过整合SPA-Cube框架，本研究考察了农业中心主义治理术如何在提供正式国家承认的同时，边缘化普南族，并揭示普南族游牧本体论如何被建构为不可辨识。分析首先审视权力背景，揭示植根于国家政策中的历史与结构性不平等，这些政策系统性地将游牧生活方式问题化。继而考察非政府组织——努桑塔拉自然保护基金会（YKAN）在利用科学研究与参与式制图支持承认过程中的权力传递策略。尽管这些策略成功获得了区级支持，但它们同时作为治理技术，通过将普南巴图人重新定义为国家可辨识的主体、对其流动的空间实践进行再领土化，并将其平等主义社会结构与习俗加以正式化，从而规训其流动性。最后，分析探讨权力调适过程，揭示干预措施引发木材公司与农业定居者的反击，强化庇护-依附网络以催生内部异议的动能。第一作者作为YKAN内部人员的身份，使得长达三年的参与式观察得以实现，提供了深度接触与独特洞见。这些内部视角通过协作研究方法加以平衡，并在参与及分析中优先贯彻整体批判性反思。在概念层面，本研究通过展示SPA-Cube框架如何阐明承认的悖论——即赋权策略可能无意中强化其所挑战的治理逻辑——为环境治理作出贡献。在实践层面，本研究凸显了现行承认范式的局限性，并为非政府组织与政策制定者提供批判性洞见。
title: Navigating power: The role of a conservation NGO in recognising and securing customary forest rights for Borneo’s last nomads
title_zh: 驾驭权力：保护非政府组织在承认和保障婆罗洲最后游牧民族传统森林权利中的作用

abstract: In the UK, aggregate emissions intensity has declined by about a factor of two over the last three decades. Prior research attributes most of this decline to reductions within industries rather than shifts in the composition of economic activity. This paper investigates whether such within-industry progress primarily reflects industry-specific factors or common forces operating across industries. Using a newly constructed panel of UK industry-level GHG emissions and gross value added for 1990–2022, we estimate a block-level dynamic factor model that decomposes changes in emissions intensity into global, block-level, and idiosyncratic components. We find that industry-specific factors account for the majority of variation in emissions intensity changes, though common shocks, either global or at the level of groups of industries, play a smaller but non-negligible role. We further show how patterns of co-movement partly reflect the way that emissions are recorded at the activity level and allocated to industries, a feature with implications for interpreting industry-level decarbonization dynamics.
abstract_zh: 在英国，过去三十年间，总体排放强度大约下降了一半。先前的研究将这一下降主要归因于行业内部的减排，而非经济活动构成的转变。本文旨在探究这种行业内部的进步究竟主要反映了行业特有的因素，还是跨行业运作的共同力量。利用我们新构建的1990年至2022年英国行业级温室气体排放及总增加值面板数据，我们估计了一个区块级动态因子模型，将排放强度的变化分解为全球性、区块级及特质性成分。研究发现，行业特有因素解释了排放强度变化中的大部分变异，尽管全球性或行业群体层面的共同冲击作用较小，但也不容忽视。我们进一步展示了共同变动模式如何部分反映排放按活动层面记录并分配到行业的方式，这一特征对解读行业级脱碳动态具有重要意义。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Do common shocks drive changes in aggregate emissions intensity?
title_zh: 共同冲击是否驱动了总排放强度的变化？

abstract: Wind power expansion is a central environmental policy objective, yet it may entail aesthetic disamenities for nearby residents. Turbine visibility often transcends administrative borders, whereas political and economic processes remain more localized. We exploit this spatial asymmetry to identify the impact of cross-jurisdictional visual exposure on support for climate mitigation policies, proxied by pro-renewable voting in Germany between 1998 and 2021. We find no electoral backlash in earlier periods, but significant declines in support in more recent elections. These dynamics are consistent with shifts in debates over wind energy expansion and the growing salience of landscape concerns, with stronger effects in rural areas and in places with organized resistance, while localized economic benefits may partly offset adverse attitudes.
abstract_zh: 风电扩张是一项核心的环境政策目标，然而它可能对邻近居民造成美学上的不便。风机可见性往往超越行政边界，而政治和经济过程则更为地方化。我们利用这种空间不对称性，来识别跨辖区视觉暴露对气候减缓政策支持度的影响，以1998年至2021年间德国支持可再生能源的投票作为代理指标。我们发现早期阶段并未出现选举反弹，但在近期的选举中支持度显著下降。这些动态与关于风电扩张辩论的转变及景观关注日益凸显的趋势相吻合，且在乡村地区及存在有组织抵抗的地方影响更为强烈，而地方经济利益可能部分抵消不利态度。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Headwind in sight? Wind turbine visibility spillovers and support for renewable energy policy
title_zh: 眼前逆风？风力涡轮机可见性溢出效应对可再生能源政策支持的影响

abstract: Using a novel database of media-reported anonymous leaks about monetary policy in the euro area, we conduct the first systematic empirical analysis of these confidential information disclosures originating from central banks. Our database reveals that Eurosystem leaks are frequent — in particular relative to leaks from other major central banks. We provide evidence that many Eurosystem leaks are likely not accidents, but placed strategically by insiders. Exploiting high-frequency financial market reactions to leaks, we find that they have large effects on markets relative to standard monetary surprises, often exceeding the impact of attributed statements by policy-makers. Yet, mainly reflecting minority opinions, leaks do not usually lock in decision-making. Post-meeting leaks regularly reveal information about dissent on the committee, changing market perceptions about the strength of the policy signal. Post-meeting leaks thereby reverse some of the initial market effect of official policy announcements.
abstract_zh: 利用一个关于欧元区货币政策媒体匿名泄密的新颖数据库，我们对源自中央银行内部的这些机密信息披露进行了首次系统性实证分析。我们的数据库显示，欧洲体系内的泄密事件频繁发生——尤其是相对于其他主要中央银行而言。我们提供的证据表明，许多欧洲体系的泄密事件可能并非偶然，而是内部人士策略性安排的。利用高频金融市场对泄密事件的反应，我们发现相对于标准的货币政策意外，这些泄密对市场产生了显著影响，往往超过政策制定者公开声明的效应。然而，主要反映少数派意见的泄密通常不会锁定决策结果。会后泄密经常揭示委员会内部的分歧信息，改变市场对政策信号强度的认知。因此，会后泄密部分逆转了官方政策公告的初始市场效应。
title: Central bank communication by ??? The economics of monetary policy leaks
title_zh: 央行沟通的谜题？货币政策泄露的经济学

abstract: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一种平均场博弈（MFG）方法，用以研究连续时空框架下空间集聚的动态过程，其中跨地区贸易可能遵循一类广泛的静态引力模型。具有前瞻性跨期效用最大化的个体在二维地理空间中工作与迁移，并面临异质性冲击。均衡工资与价格取决于他们的共同分布，并根据底层贸易模型静态调整。我们首先证明静态贸易均衡的存在性与唯一性。随后证明动态均衡的存在性。在环形经济情形下，我们获得了稳态附近小扰动的闭式解，并识别出导致集聚或分散的参数集合。我们利用模型的MFG结构，明确量化不确定性与前瞻性预期对集聚和分散的贡献。特别地，我们表明，无论静态贸易模型如何，前瞻性预期总是促进集聚，但无法逆转在短视行为下将占主导地位的格局。
title: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
title_zh: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论

abstract: Repeated interactions can sustain cooperation even when short-run incentives favor defection, but the individual strategies underlying such cooperation remain poorly understood. We study behavior in indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma experiments and identify three robust behavioral types: defectors defectors, cautious cooperators, and strong cooperators. Both types of cooperators tend to continue cooperation after mutual cooperation, defect after mutual defection, and randomize after asymmetric outcomes, differing mainly in their initial willingness to cooperate. Variation in the strategic environment primarily changes the population shares of these types rather than their continuation behavior. These findings suggest that cooperation in repeated interactions is sustained by a small number of robust behavioral patterns. At the same time, the continuation behavior of cooperating types is largely insensitive to expected payoffs, contrary to standard game-theoretic predictions.
abstract_zh: 重复互动即使在短期激励倾向于背叛的情况下也能维持合作，但支撑这种合作的个体策略仍鲜为人知。我们研究了无限重复囚徒困境实验中的行为，并识别出三种稳健的行为类型：背叛者、谨慎合作者和强合作者。两类合作者在相互合作后倾向于继续合作，在相互背叛后选择背叛，在不对称结果后随机选择，主要区别在于初始合作意愿。战略环境的变化主要改变这些类型在总体中的占比，而非其后续行为。这些发现表明，重复互动中的合作由少数稳健的行为模式所维持。同时，合作类型的后续行为对预期收益基本不敏感，这与标准博弈论预测相悖。
title: Individual strategy choice in the repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
title_zh: 重复囚徒困境中的个体策略选择

abstract: While the benefits of cash transfers are well documented, little attention has been given to the negative effects of their cessation, particularly on mental health. We examined this question using South African longitudinal survey data comprising 7899 unique adolescents tracked as they age out of the Child Support Grant , the country’s largest cash transfer. We find that loss of the Child Support Grant leads to a decline in mental health equivalent to 0.42 of a standard deviation in the CES-D score, robust across model specifications and falsification tests. Increased job search activity points to resource mobilisation as a plausible mechanism, consistent with the Conservation of Resources framework. Effects are concentrated among adolescents in urban areas and households with lower and less diversified income. The results point to a neglected aspect of social protection: how and when cash transfers are withdrawn, particularly when this coincides with critical life stages.
abstract_zh: 尽管现金转移支付的好处已有充分记录，但其终止所带来的负面影响，尤其是对心理健康的影响，却鲜少受到关注。我们利用南非纵向调查数据，追踪了7899名青少年在退出该国最大现金转移项目——儿童抚养补助金——过程中的情况，来探讨这一问题。研究发现，失去儿童抚养补助金会导致心理健康状况下降，相当于CES-D评分中0.42个标准差的变化，这一结果在多种模型设定和证伪检验中均保持稳健。求职活动的增加表明资源动员是一个可能的机制，这与资源保护理论框架相符。影响主要集中在城市地区及收入较低且来源单一的青少年家庭中。这些结果揭示了社会保护中被忽视的一个方面：现金转移支付如何及何时被撤回，尤其是当这一过程与关键生命阶段相重叠时。
title: The mental health impact for adolescents ageing out of South Africa’s child support grant
title_zh: 南非儿童抚养补助金到期对青少年心理健康的影响

abstract: Why do elite families often maintain their social and economic status across generations? This paper examines the role of adoption in sustaining elite persistence in prewar Japan. Under the Japanese inheritance system, families without a biological son could adopt an heir to continue the family lineage and transfer assets and social status. Using novel father–heir linked data constructed from the Personnel Inquiry Records (1903–39), we compare elite outcomes between biological and adopted heirs. We find that adopted heirs were substantially more likely to remain elite and to reach the extreme upper tail of the income distribution than biological heirs. The results are robust to family, regional, occupational, and educational controls. Overall, the findings suggest that adoption functioned as an institutional mechanism that expanded the pool of potential successors beyond biological lineage, thereby strengthening intergenerational elite persistence in prewar Japan.
abstract_zh: 为何精英家族常能代际维持其社会经济地位？本文考察了收养制度在战前日本精英持续性中的作用。在日本继承制度下，无亲生儿子的家族可通过收养继承人延续家族血脉并转移资产与社会地位。利用《人事调查记录》（1903-1939年）构建的新型父子关联数据，我们比较了亲生继承人与收养继承人的精英地位结果。研究发现，收养继承人比亲生继承人更可能维持精英地位并进入收入分配的极端顶端。该结果在控制家庭、区域、职业及教育变量后依然稳健。总体而言，研究结果表明，收养作为一种制度机制，将潜在继承人的范围扩展至血缘关系之外，从而强化了战前日本的代际精英持续性。
title: Elite persistence in family: The role of adoption in prewar Japan
title_zh: 家族中的精英延续：战前日本收养制度的作用

abstract: We quantitatively analyze the impact of US banking deregulation in the 1980s on the aggregate economy. Using recent econometric techniques, we first reexamine existing empirical evidence on the real effects of banking deregulation. We then construct a quantitative model that integrates imperfectly competitive banks into a general equilibrium framework of firm dynamics and occupational choice. Consistent with the empirical evidence, deregulation significantly increases output growth and firm entry. Increased competition among banks and the entrepreneurs' occupational choices play an important role in shaping the economy's response to deregulation.
abstract_zh: 本文定量分析了20世纪80年代美国银行业放松管制对总体经济的影响。利用最新的计量经济学方法，我们首先重新审视了关于银行业放松管制实际效应的现有实证证据。随后，我们构建了一个将不完全竞争银行纳入企业动态与职业选择一般均衡框架的定量模型。与实证证据一致，放松管制显著提升了产出增长与企业进入率。银行间竞争的加剧以及企业家的职业选择在塑造经济对放松管制的反应中发挥了关键作用。
title: Entrepreneurship and Financial Deregulation
title_zh: 创业与金融放松管制

abstract: The transition toward a circular economy (CE) represents not only an economic shift but also a profound social and institutional transformation that redefines production, consumption, and policy. This study provides the first macro-level empirical assessment of the CE transition across European regions over the last two decades. It then examines how regional regulative, normative, and cultural-cognitive institutions shape regional CE performance, while also accounting for key confounding factors, including EU cohesion funds, regional autonomy, and the EU Circular Economy Action Plan (CEAP). The results reveal strong spatial and temporal heterogeneity, as well as distinct effects across institutional dimensions. Regulative institutions exhibit the most consistent positive association across and within countries. Normative institutions matter most within major regions, while cultural-cognitive institutions provide more modest support for CE efforts. Importantly, the combination of all institutional pillars is associated with the largest gains in circularity. EU cohesion funds significantly support CE progress, while the post-2015 results suggest that the CEAP reshaped the relative importance of institutional pillars. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of coordinated institutional frameworks and targeted policy support in advancing the regional CE transition.
abstract_zh: 向循环经济（CE）的转型不仅代表着经济层面的转变，更是一场深刻的社会与制度变革，重新定义了生产、消费及政策。本研究首次对过去二十年间欧洲各地区的循环经济转型进行了宏观层面的实证评估，并进一步探讨了区域规制性、规范性及文化-认知性制度如何影响区域循环经济绩效，同时控制了包括欧盟凝聚力基金、区域自治权及欧盟循环经济行动计划（CEAP）在内的关键混淆因素。研究结果显示，循环经济转型存在显著的空间与时间异质性，且各制度维度的影响效应各异。规制性制度在国家内部及国家间均展现出最为一致的正向关联；规范性制度在主要区域中作用最为显著；而文化-认知性制度对循环经济努力的支撑作用相对有限。重要的是，所有制度支柱的组合与循环性提升的最大增益相关联。欧盟凝聚力基金显著促进了循环经济进展，而2015年后的结果表明，CEAP重塑了各制度支柱的相对重要性。总体而言，研究结果强调了协调的制度框架与有针对性的政策支持在推进区域循环经济转型中的关键作用。
title: Circular economy transition of European regions: The role of regulative, normative, and cultural–cognitive institutions
title_zh: 欧洲区域循环经济转型：规制性、规范性与文化认知性制度的作用

abstract: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies. (JEL D14, H42, G18, P16)
abstract_zh: 关于绿色投资的一个核心担忧是，它可能会挤占公众对解决负外部性问题的公共政策的政治支持。我们在瑞士一项气候法案全民公投前夕开展了一项预注册实验，对此进行了检验。研究发现，提供投资气候友好型基金的机会，并不会降低个人对气候监管的支持（以政治捐款和投票意向衡量）。在英国重复该实验后得到了类似结果。我们的估计结果否定了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持存在适度的挤入效应。（JEL D14, H42, G18, P16）
title: Green Investing and Political Behavior
title_zh: 绿色投资与政治行为

abstract: This study uses hand-collected data to investigate the impact of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on corporate investment in India. We use a panel of 1,666 firms with 16,869 firm-year observations from 2001 to 2022. We find that the interaction between political uncertainty and corruption negatively affects firm-level investments, and that firms close to political power face greater political uncertainty. These findings are consistent across multiple robustness checks. We further validate the results by employing a Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework and using the 2018 Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act as a quasi-natural experiment to check investment patterns. The strong anti-corruption measures helped alleviate the negative impact of political uncertainty and corruption. Overall, the study highlights the adverse effect of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on firm-level investments.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用手工收集的数据，考察了印度邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业投资的影响。我们采用了一个包含2001年至2022年间1,666家企业、共16,869个企业-年度观测值的面板数据。研究发现，政治不确定性与腐败之间的交互作用对企业层面投资产生负面影响，且靠近政治权力的企业面临更高的政治不确定性。这些发现在多项稳健性检验中保持一致。我们进一步通过采用双重差分（DID）框架，并利用2018年《反腐败（修正）法案》作为准自然实验来验证投资模式，从而确认了上述结果。强有力的反腐败措施有助于缓解政治不确定性和腐败的负面影响。总体而言，本研究强调了邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业层面投资的不利影响。
title: Political uncertainty, corruption, and corporate investment: evidence from India
title_zh: 政治不确定性、腐败与企业投资：来自印度的证据

abstract: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究了人们对经济的信念如何随家庭层面事件而变化。研究发现，相较于实际通胀率，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期的未来家庭收入变化指标之间存在显著更强的负向协动关系。我们正式证明，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（"回溯预测"），表明不完美回忆是导致预测偏差的关键机制。在此基础上，一系列附加检验（部分利用不良健康事件数据）表明，预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索回忆——即负面（正面）家庭层面事件会触发负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。
title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据

abstract: No. Elite institutions offer high salaries because they hire the most valued faculty. Moreover, in contrast to the broader labor market, faculty are equally likely to move up and down the prestige ladder, and they increase their salary either way. We speculate that these facts reflect the visible nature of faculty productivity and the sporadic nature of academic job openings.
abstract_zh: 摘要编号。精英机构之所以提供高薪，是因为它们聘用了最具价值的教职员工。此外，与更广泛的劳动力市场不同，教职员工在声望阶梯上向上或向下流动的可能性相当，且无论哪种流动方向，他们的薪资都会增加。我们推测，这些事实反映了教职员工生产力的可见性以及学术职位空缺的偶发性。
title: Do Elite Universities Overpay Their Faculty?
title_zh: 精英大学是否向其教师支付过高薪酬？

abstract: As manufacturing firms expand globally, business services such as advertising and legal support become essential for entering new markets. Exploiting exogenous demand shocks, we document that French manufacturers increasingly outsource market-access services as they enter more destinations. We develop a theory of market-access costs in which firms weigh the managerial strain of internal provision against adaptation costs of outsourcing—a mechanism that receives empirical sup-port. Further explorations reveal that outsourcing market-access services helps explain variation in access costs related to gravity and extended gravity, affects both sunk and fixed export costs, and substantially amplifies the variety gains from trade liberalization.
abstract_zh: 随着制造业企业全球扩张，广告和法律支持等商业服务成为进入新市场的关键。利用外生需求冲击，我们发现法国制造商在进入更多目的地市场时，会越来越多地将市场准入服务外包。我们构建了一个市场准入成本理论，其中企业需权衡内部提供的管理压力与外包的适应成本——这一机制得到了实证支持。进一步研究表明，外包市场准入服务有助于解释与引力模型及扩展引力模型相关的准入成本差异，同时影响出口的沉没成本和固定成本，并显著放大了贸易自由化带来的品种增益。
title: Managing Export Complexity: The Role of Service Outsourcing
title_zh: 管理出口复杂性：服务外包的作用

abstract: We document a series of stylized facts about how firms seek to protect the rents from innovation, using a large nationally representative survey of U.S. businesses over the period 2008-2015. Just 1.4 percent of firms obtain patents, but these patenting firms account for 87 percent of R&D investment. Firms consider utility patents less important than other forms of IP protection, like trade secrets, trademarks, and copyrights. Firm industry and size are strongly correlated with firms’ use of all types of intellectual property, but firm-age is not. Implications for innovation research and policy are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008-2015年间美国企业的大规模全国代表性调查数据，系统记录了企业如何寻求保护创新租金的一系列典型事实。仅有1.4%的企业获得专利，但这些专利企业却占据了研发投资的87%。企业认为实用专利的重要性低于其他形式的知识产权保护，如商业秘密、商标和版权。企业所属行业和规模与其使用各类知识产权的行为高度相关，但企业年龄则不然。本文讨论了这些发现对创新研究与政策制定的启示。
title: Innovation, Patenting and Appropriability: Survey Evidence from a Nationally Representative Sample of U.S. Firms
title_zh: 创新、专利与专有性：基于美国企业全国代表性样本的调查证据

abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines the role of information in pharmaceutical detailing (promotional interactions between drug representatives and physicians). We start with a theoretical framework in which pharmaceutical firms target detailing visits to physicians who learn about drug quality and prescribe accordingly. We derive several predictions about the role of information in these visits, which we then test empirically using prescriptions and pharmaceutical detailing visit data. We find limited empirical support of learning as the dominant mechanism, though cannot rule it out completely. We conclude with discussing alternative models that may be more consistent with the observed empirical patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证角度探讨信息在药品推广拜访（即医药代表与医生之间的促销互动）中的作用。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，其中制药企业针对医生进行定向推广拜访，医生通过此类拜访了解药品质量并据此开具处方。基于此框架，我们推导出关于信息在推广拜访中作用的若干预测，并利用处方数据与药品推广拜访数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，学习机制作为主导解释的实证支持有限，但无法完全排除其可能性。最后，我们讨论了与观察到的实证模式更为一致的替代模型。
title: The Role of Information in Pharmaceutical Advertising: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 信息在药品广告中的作用：理论与证据

abstract: We examine the effect of investments by large technology firms on innovation by AI startups. Large technology firms have substantial advantages in data, a key non-rival input for developing AI technology. We assemble a unique dataset containing approximately 9,800 AI-inventing startups in China. Using a triple-differences strategy, we find that AI startups receiving investments from large technology firms file more AI patent applications and develop more software products following the investment, relative to their counterparts receiving investments from other firms without data advantages. Finally, we provide novel evidence that the innovation effect works mainly through sharing non-rival data.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了大型科技企业的投资对人工智能初创企业创新的影响。大型科技企业在数据这一人工智能技术开发的关键非竞争性投入方面具有显著优势。我们构建了一个包含约9800家中国人工智能初创企业的独特数据集。采用三重差分策略，我们发现，相较于接受其他不具备数据优势企业投资的同类初创企业，获得大型科技企业投资的人工智能初创企业在投资后提交了更多人工智能专利申请，并开发了更多软件产品。最后，我们提供了新的证据表明，这种创新效应主要通过共享非竞争性数据实现。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Investments and Innovation with Non-Rival Inputs: Evidence from Chinese Artificial Intelligence Startups
title_zh: 非竞争性投入下的投资与创新：来自中国人工智能初创企业的证据

abstract: This paper develops a semiparametric sieve approach to estimate impulse response functions of nonlinear time series models within a broad class of structural autoregressive specifications. A two-step procedure flexibly captures nonlinearities without imposing fixed parametric forms. We establish uniform estimation guarantees and propose an iterative algorithm that makes impulse response computation straightforward. Simulation results show robustness to misspecification with only modest efficiency losses. In an application to U.S. monetary policy, we find larger GDP responses to interest rate hikes than in linear models. We also examine oil supply news shocks of varying magnitudes to assess limitations when analyzing large shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种半参数筛分方法，用于在广泛的结构自回归模型类别中估计非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应函数。该两步法无需设定固定参数形式，即可灵活捕捉非线性特征。我们建立了均匀估计保证，并提出一种迭代算法，使脉冲响应计算变得简便。模拟结果表明，该方法对模型误设具有稳健性，且仅带来适度的效率损失。在应用于美国货币政策时，我们发现利率上调对GDP的影响大于线性模型的结果。此外，我们考察了不同幅度的石油供给新闻冲击，以评估分析大规模冲击时的局限性。
title: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
title_zh: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析

abstract: We examine the impact of firearm violence on newborn health in the U.S. using two approaches. First, we analyze the “beltway sniper” attacks in 2002, leveraging both temporal and spatial variation to compare birth outcomes of exposed children to those unexposed. Second, we investigate in-utero exposure to mass shootings using national data. We find that exposure to these incidents during pregnancy increases the likelihood of very low-birthweight and very premature birth. These events carry a significant economic burden, with the beltway sniper attacks costing at least $155 million and mass shootings resulting in annual costs exceeding $75 million.
abstract_zh: 本文采用两种方法考察美国枪支暴力对新生儿健康的影响。首先，我们以2002年"环城狙击手"袭击事件为研究对象，利用时间与空间双重变异，比较受暴露儿童与未受暴露儿童的出生结局。其次，我们运用全国数据探究产前接触大规模枪击事件的影响。研究发现，孕期暴露于此类事件会显著增加极低出生体重和极早产的发生概率。这些事件带来沉重的经济负担——"环城狙击手"袭击事件至少造成1.55亿美元损失，而大规模枪击事件每年产生的成本超过7500万美元。
title: The Hidden Cost of Firearm Violence on Infants in Utero
title_zh: 枪支暴力对胎儿期婴儿的隐性成本

abstract: Predictive algorithms inform consequential decisions in settings with selective labels: outcomes are observed only for units selected by past decision makers. This creates an identification problem under unobserved confounding — when selected and unselected units differ in unobserved ways that affect outcomes. We propose a framework for robust design and evaluation of predictive algorithms that bounds how much outcomes may differ between selected and unselected units with the same observed characteristics. These bounds formalize common empirical strategies including proxy outcomes and instrumental variables. Our estimators work across bounding strategies and performance measures such as conditional likelihoods, mean squared error, and true/false positive rates. Using administrative data from a large Australian financial institution, we show that varying confounding assumptions substantially affects credit risk predictions and fairness evaluations across income groups.
abstract_zh: 摘要 预测算法在存在选择性标签的情境中影响关键决策：仅当个体被过往决策者选中时，其结果才可观测。这会在未观测混杂因素存在时引发识别问题——即被选中与未被选中的个体在影响结果的未观测维度上存在差异。我们提出一个预测算法稳健设计与评估框架，通过界定具有相同可观测特征的被选中与未被选中个体之间结果差异的上限，将代理结果与工具变量等常见实证策略形式化。该框架的估计量适用于不同边界策略及条件似然、均方误差、真/假阳性率等性能指标。基于澳大利亚某大型金融机构的行政数据，我们证明混杂假设的差异会显著影响不同收入群体的信用风险预测与公平性评估。
title: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
title_zh: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估

abstract: Court capture in developing countries is pervasive, yet its economic effects remain underexplored. We study a Chinese reform that transferred financial and personnel authority over local courts from local to provincial governments. Exploiting the staggered roll-out, we find a 7.3% decline in local defendants’ win rates against non-local plaintiffs, alongside improved judicial quality. The reform encouraged smaller non-local firms to litigate and attracted non-local investment, potentially raising GDP by 1.9%. Yet favoritism toward politically connected firms and inter-provincial protectionism remain, and centralization itself promotes less qualified judges— revealing both its promise and limits.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家普遍存在法院被地方俘获的现象，但其经济影响尚未得到充分研究。本文研究了中国将地方法院的财政与人事管理权从地方政府转移至省级政府的改革。利用该改革分阶段推行的特征，我们发现本地被告对非本地原告的胜诉率下降7.3%，同时司法质量得到提升。改革鼓励小型非本地企业提起诉讼并吸引非本地投资，可能使GDP增长1.9%。然而，对政治关联企业的偏袒及省际保护主义依然存在，且集权化本身导致法官资质下降——这揭示了改革的成效与局限。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
title_zh: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据

abstract: Televised debates between presidential candidates are often regarded as the exemplar of persuasive communication. Yet, recent evidence from Le Pennec and Pons (2023) indicates that they may not sway voters as strongly as popular belief suggests. We revisit their findings through the lens of the persuasion rate and introduce a robust framework that does not require exogenous treatment, parallel trends, or credible instruments. Instead, we leverage plausible monotonicity assumptions to partially identify the persuasion rate and related parameters. Our results reaffirm that the sharp upper bounds on the persuasive effects of TV debates remain modest.
abstract_zh: 摘要 总统候选人之间的电视辩论常被视为说服性传播的典范。然而，Le Pennec与Pons（2023）的最新证据表明，其影响选民的程度可能远不及普遍认知。我们通过说服率视角重新审视其研究发现，并引入一个无需外生处理、平行趋势或可信工具变量的稳健框架。相反，我们利用合理的单调性假设对说服率及相关参数进行部分识别。研究结果再次证实，电视辩论说服效应的严格上界仍较为有限。
title: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
title_zh: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响

abstract: Electric vehicles are key to decarbonizing transportation, but, as batteries-on-wheels, they present novel challenges and opportunities for grids simultaneously transitioning to renewable energy. In a field experiment tracking 390 electric vehicles minute-by-minute, we show that time-based charging incentives dramatically shift not only when vehicles are charged, but also where. Incentives to increase charging during solar energy generation hours lead to a 34% rise in charging—mostly outside the home. Incentives to reduce peak time charging result in 17%—27% lower charging—mostly at home. Participants demonstrate multiple responses to incentives, including shifting time and location of charging, reducing charging by driving less, and lowering their battery state-of-charge. We find stronger midday charging responses for commuters and those with fast home chargers, and suggestive evidence that commuters increase use of workplace charging. Tariffs and charging infrastructure, therefore, need to be designed in tandem to manage the critical time and location imbalances brought about by the net-zero transition.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车是实现交通脱碳的关键，但作为“轮子上的电池”，它们同时为正在向可再生能源转型的电网带来了新的挑战与机遇。在一项对390辆电动汽车进行分钟级追踪的实地实验中，我们展示了基于时间的充电激励不仅显著改变了车辆的充电时间，还改变了充电地点。激励措施鼓励在太阳能发电高峰时段增加充电，导致充电量上升34%——其中大部分发生在家庭之外。而旨在减少高峰时段充电的激励措施则使充电量下降17%至27%——其中大部分发生在家庭内部。参与者对激励措施表现出多种响应，包括调整充电时间和地点、通过减少驾驶来降低充电需求，以及降低电池荷电状态。我们发现，通勤者及拥有快速家用充电桩的参与者对午间充电的响应更为强烈，并有初步证据表明通勤者增加了工作场所充电的使用。因此，电价机制与充电基础设施需要协同设计，以应对净零转型所带来的关键时间与地点上的不平衡。
title: Can electric vehicles aid the renewable transition? Evidence from a field experiment incentivizing midday charging
title_zh: 电动汽车能否助力可再生能源转型？来自激励午间充电实地实验的证据

abstract: In 1965–1966, Chile built and staffed thousands of new primary classrooms in supply-constrained communities. Using a quasi-experimental design and large census samples, we show that childhood exposure to school construction improved the schooling and labor market outcomes of adults and closed a persistent female disadvantage in school attainment. Women’s exposure to the policy had large intergenerational spillovers on their children’s on-time grade progression and completed schooling. The marginal value of public funds is 13, including direct effects on adults and intergenerational spillovers.
abstract_zh: 1965年至1966年间，智利在供给受限的社区新建并配备了数千间小学教室。利用准实验设计和大规模人口普查样本，我们发现，童年时期接触学校建设改善了成年人的教育程度和劳动力市场表现，并缩小了女性在教育成就上长期存在的不利差距。女性受该政策影响对其子女的按时升学进度及最终受教育年限产生了显著的代际溢出效应。公共资金的边际价值为13，其中包括对成年人的直接影响及代际溢出效应。
title: Building opportunity: the intergenerational effects of Chilean school construction
title_zh: 创造机会：智利学校建设的代际效应

abstract: The expansion of solar energy has brought land to the center of energy policy debates, yet the governance processes that determine how land is allocated, contested, and transformed remain insufficiently understood. This article examines how solar deployment reshapes land-use governance through the interaction between top-down state authority and bottom-up local claims across open landscapes, built environments, and productive agricultural lands. Israel provides a revealing setting, as land scarcity and a centralised land regime heighten the stakes of solar siting and make governance tensions visible. Drawing on a qualitative case study based on regulatory documents, governmental protocols, stakeholder materials, field visits, and 26 semi-structured interviews, the analysis shows that solar siting generates distinct temporal, spatial, and distributive effects. National authorities accelerate deployment and set spatial priorities that treat territories as readily available for development. Municipalities, communities, and landholders respond by mobilizing ecological knowledge, asserting community rights, and advancing alternative visions of land value. These encounters shape which landscapes host solar infrastructure, which land uses are displaced or preserved, and how transition benefits and burdens are distributed. Although grounded in Israel, these mechanisms extend more broadly. Across settings, solar expansion operates less as a uniform national strategy than as a negotiated reconfiguration of territorial authority, land politics, and spatial meaning. The findings demonstrate that the energy transition is also a land-use transition. For land-use policy, this underscores the need for governance arrangements that balance national goals with place-based priorities and enable renewable energy development to proceed in legitimate and spatially just ways.
abstract_zh: 太阳能扩张已将土地置于能源政策辩论的核心，然而决定土地如何被分配、争夺和改造的治理过程仍未得到充分理解。本文考察太阳能部署如何通过自上而下的国家权威与自下而上的地方诉求在开阔景观、建成环境和生产性农业用地中的互动，重塑土地利用治理。以色列提供了一个具有揭示性的研究场景，因为土地稀缺和集中化的土地制度提高了太阳能选址的利害关系，使治理张力清晰可见。基于对监管文件、政府议定书、利益相关者材料、实地考察以及26次半结构化访谈的定性案例研究，分析表明太阳能选址产生了不同的时间、空间和分配效应。国家主管部门加速部署并设定空间优先次序，将领土视为可随时用于开发。市政当局、社区和土地所有者则通过调动生态知识、主张社区权利以及提出土地价值的替代愿景来回应。这些交锋塑造了哪些景观承载太阳能基础设施、哪些土地利用被取代或保留，以及转型收益与负担如何分配。尽管以以色列为背景，这些机制具有更广泛的适用性。在不同情境下，太阳能扩张与其说是一项统一的国家战略，不如说是一种对领土权威、土地政治和空间意义的协商性重构。研究结果表明，能源转型同时也是土地利用转型。对土地利用政策而言，这凸显了治理安排的必要性，即在国家目标与地方优先事项之间取得平衡，并使可再生能源开发以合法且空间公正的方式推进。
title: The politics of land in Israel’s solar transition: Top-down and bottom-up governance
title_zh: 以色列太阳能转型中的土地政治：自上而下与自下而上的治理

abstract: Policy coherence is widely recognised as essential for achieving food systems transformation, but attempts to assess food systems policy coherence have been limited to date in terms of their scope of topics and geographies and lack of comparable methods. This paper introduces the Food Systems Policy Coherence (FSPC) Diagnostic Tool and uses it to analyse food systems policy coherence across 10 low- and middle-income countries in Africa and Asia through key informant interviews (n = 189) and review of policy documents (n = 808). The FSPC Diagnostic Tool considers two aspects of policy coherence: (1) the structures and mechanisms that may contribute to achieving stronger policy process coherence and (2) coherence between policies from six sectors and ten common food systems goals. Regarding the former, all countries analysed had strong framework documents for cross-sectoral food policy, backed by high-level political commitment, but they tended to be much weaker when it came to capacity for implementation and especially monitoring and accountability. Policy coherence across sectors was generally strong for the goals of climate change adaptation and social protection but weaker for goals of healthy diets for all, adequate wages for food system workers, and climate change mitigation through food systems. Trade policy was the policy area with the greatest incoherence with a diverse range of food systems goals. The results offer the most comprehensive analysis of food systems policy coherence to date. The tool makes a useful contribution to measuring policy coherence and can serve as both a foundation for future research and enhance accountability for achieving coherent policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 政策一致性被广泛认为是实现粮食系统转型的关键，但迄今为止，对粮食系统政策一致性的评估在主题和地理范围上均有限，且缺乏可比方法。本文介绍了粮食系统政策一致性（FSPC）诊断工具，并通过关键知情人访谈（n=189）及政策文件审查（n=808），运用该工具对非洲和亚洲10个低收入和中等收入国家的粮食系统政策一致性进行了分析。FSPC诊断工具考量了政策一致性的两个方面：（1）可能有助于实现更强政策过程一致性的结构与机制；（2）六个部门政策与十个常见粮食系统目标之间的一致性。就前者而言，所有被分析国家均拥有强有力的跨部门粮食政策框架文件，并得到高层政治承诺的支持，但在实施能力，尤其是监测与问责方面，往往显得较为薄弱。跨部门政策一致性在气候变化适应和社会保护目标上普遍较强，但在全民健康饮食、粮食系统工作者合理工资以及通过粮食系统减缓气候变化等目标上则较弱。贸易政策是与多种粮食系统目标不一致性最大的政策领域。这些结果提供了迄今为止对粮食系统政策一致性最全面的分析。该工具对衡量政策一致性做出了有益贡献，既可作为未来研究的基础，也能增强实现一致性政策成果的问责性。
title: Food systems policy coherence: A ten-country assessment
title_zh: 粮食系统政策一致性：十国评估

abstract: Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we provide a comprehensive investigation of the relationship between workplace co-determination in the form of works councils and income satisfaction. Controlling for a wide range of individual, job-related, and firm-level characteristics in OLS and fixed effects specifications, we observe that employees working in establishments with a works council report significantly higher income satisfaction compared to their counterparts in non-co-determined firms. Rank in the income distribution, perceived fairness of the wage, and working conditions emerge as quantitatively relevant factors in explaining the positive correlation.
abstract_zh: 基于德国社会经济面板数据，本文全面考察了以企业职工委员会为形式的职场共同决策与收入满意度之间的关系。在控制个体、岗位及企业层面广泛特征变量的OLS与固定效应模型中，我们发现：相较于非共同决策企业，设有职工委员会企业的员工报告的收入满意度显著更高。收入分配位次、工资公平感知及工作条件是解释这一正向关联的关键量化因素。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Councils of contentment: works councils and income perceptions
title_zh: 满足的委员会：企业职工委员会与收入感知

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted labour markets globally, intensifying inequalities and reshaping employment structures. In Vietnam, migrants who relocated in search of a higher income were disproportionately affected, and non-migrant workers faced distinct challenges. Using data from the Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey 2018–2022, this study applies propensity score matching to investigate the effect of migration on labour income. Although migrant workers earned more than non-migrant workers, they experienced greater income volatility during the pandemic and recovery periods. Stratified analyses revealed the diverse effects of migration on income. Although the pandemic created short-term job opportunities that were more accessible to migrants owing to their specific characteristics, the surge in demand was temporary. In the post-pandemic period, labour market conditions returned to normal, and a gradual transition towards automation and digitalization shifted labour demand in favour of more skilled and digitally literate workers. Consequently, migration benefits have become more pronounced for high-school graduates than for less-educated individuals. These findings highlight the importance of policies that promote lifelong learning and employment protection alongside investments in education, vocational training, and digital access. Such measures are essential for building adaptive, inclusive, and resilient labour markets.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情扰乱了全球劳动力市场，加剧了不平等并重塑了就业结构。在越南，为寻求更高收入而迁移的移民受到了不成比例的影响，而非移民工人则面临独特的挑战。本研究利用2018至2022年越南家庭生活标准调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配法考察迁移对劳动收入的影响。尽管移民工人的收入高于非移民工人，但在疫情期间及恢复阶段，他们经历了更大的收入波动。分层分析揭示了迁移对收入的多重影响。尽管疫情创造了短期就业机会，由于移民的特定特征，这些机会对他们更为可及，但需求的激增是暂时的。疫情后时期，劳动力市场条件恢复正常，向自动化和数字化的逐步转型使劳动力需求转向更倾向于技能更高和数字素养更强的工人。因此，迁移带来的收益对高中毕业生而言比教育程度较低者更为显著。这些发现强调了促进终身学习和就业保障政策的重要性，同时需加大对教育、职业培训和数字接入的投资。此类措施对于构建适应性、包容性和韧性的劳动力市场至关重要。
title: Heterogeneous impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on income amongst employed migrants and non-migrants in Vietnam
title_zh: 越南就业移民与非移民群体中新冠疫情对收入影响的异质性分析

abstract: Generative AI is reshaping the book industry, raising critical questions about intellectual property and fair compensation. While legal and general user perspectives have been widely examined, authors’ views remain under-explored. This study addresses that gap by examining whether authors are willing to allow their works to be used in AI training and what compensation they expect for existing and future works. Using survey data from members of the Australian Society of Authors, we apply Seemingly Unrelated Bivariate Probit and Seemingly Unrelated Regression models to identify key factors shaping these decisions. Results show that authors’ willingness to allow AI training is influenced by their fairness perceptions, prior beliefs about AI training, and patterns of AI use, while compensation expectations are primarily driven by concerns about replacement risk and income loss. These findings contribute new evidence to debates on AI, copyright, and creative labour markets.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正在重塑图书产业，引发了关于知识产权和公平补偿的关键问题。尽管法律和普通用户的视角已被广泛研究，但作者的看法仍未得到充分探讨。本研究通过考察作者是否愿意允许其作品用于AI训练，以及他们对现有和未来作品期望获得何种补偿，来填补这一空白。利用澳大利亚作家协会成员的调查数据，我们应用似不相关双变量Probit模型和似不相关回归模型，识别影响这些决策的关键因素。结果显示，作者允许AI训练的意愿受其公平感知、对AI训练的既有信念以及AI使用模式的影响，而补偿期望则主要由对替代风险和收入损失的担忧驱动。这些发现为关于AI、版权和创意劳动力市场的辩论提供了新的证据。
title: Write incentives? Authors’ sentiment on generative AI
title_zh: 生成式人工智能对作者激励的影响：基于情感分析

abstract: We study how interpersonal information projection bias influences a researcher’s decision to implement a current idea or to continue drawing new ones. Consistent misbeliefs, such as overconfidence or underconfidence, distort beliefs in a fixed manner. In contrast, information projection creates state-dependent beliefs: before an idea arises, the researcher is optimistic about its uniqueness, and once the idea is in hand, the researcher becomes pessimistic. This fluctuation makes implementation less attractive and makes repeated searches more appealing. Our analysis yields two key findings. First, compared to any consistent-misbelief researcher whose fixed belief falls between the optimistic and pessimistic assessments of the information projection researcher, the information projection researcher is more selective: implementing less, drawing more ideas, and quitting less frequently. Second, at sufficiently high performance thresholds, researchers who end up passing the threshold are disproportionately information projection researchers. Consequently, information projection systematically biases both individual search dynamics and the composition of such researchers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究人际信息投射偏差如何影响研究者决定实施当前想法还是继续构思新想法。一致的错误信念，如过度自信或信心不足，会以固定方式扭曲信念。相比之下，信息投射产生依赖于状态的信念：在想法出现之前，研究者对其独特性持乐观态度；而一旦想法在手，研究者则变得悲观。这种波动使得实施想法的吸引力降低，而重复搜索则更具吸引力。我们的分析得出两个关键发现。首先，与任何固定信念介于信息投射研究者乐观与悲观评估之间的一致错误信念研究者相比，信息投射研究者更具选择性：实施更少、构思更多、放弃频率更低。其次，在足够高的绩效门槛下，最终通过门槛的研究者中，信息投射研究者占比不成比例地高。因此，信息投射系统性地偏差了个体搜索动态以及此类研究者的构成。
title: Information projection and selective search: Implement now or draw again
title_zh: 信息投射与选择性搜索：立即实施还是重新抽取

abstract: Using a new equilibrium representation, I characterize dynamic, nonstationary risk sharing in a complete-information setting among strategic traders submitting demand schedules and heterogeneous in risk aversion. In equilibrium, more risk-averse (smaller) traders diversify more aggressively due to endogenously lower price impact. This creates term structure effects, where smaller traders dynamically hedge the persistent order flow of larger, slower traders and become the marginal pricers at short horizons. When pre-announced security issuances (e.g., bond reopenings) or predictable trades take place, the model generates the gradual, V-shaped price response observed around these events and delivers new predictions about institutional trading.
abstract_zh: 利用一种新的均衡表示方法，我刻画了在完全信息环境中，风险规避程度异质的策略性交易者提交需求曲线时的动态、非平稳风险分担特征。在均衡状态下，风险规避程度更高（规模更小）的交易者因内生性较低的价格冲击效应而更为积极地分散风险。这产生了期限结构效应，其中较小规模的交易者动态对冲较大且行动较慢交易者的持续性订单流，并在短期视野内成为边际定价者。当预先公告的证券发行（例如债券重新开放）或可预测交易发生时，模型生成了围绕这些事件观察到的渐进式V形价格反应，并为机构交易提供了新的预测。
title: Asymmetric thin markets
title_zh: 非对称性薄市场

abstract: This paper proposes a correlated random coefficient linear panel data model, where regressors can be correlated with time-varying and individual-specific random coefficients through both a fixed effect and a time-varying random shock. I develop a new panel data-based method to identify the average partial effect and the local average response function. The identification strategy employs a sufficient statistic to control for the fixed effect and a control variable for the random shock. Conditional on these two controls, the residual variation in the regressors is driven solely by the exogenous instrumental variables, and thus can be exploited to identify the parameters of interest. The constructive identification analysis leads to three-step series estimators, for which I establish rates of convergence and asymptotic normality. To illustrate the method, I estimate a heterogeneous Cobb-Douglas production function for manufacturing firms in China, finding substantial variations in output elasticities across firms that can be related to various firm characteristics.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种相关随机系数线性面板数据模型，其中回归元可通过固定效应和时变随机冲击与个体特定的时变随机系数相关。我开发了一种基于面板数据的新方法，以识别平均部分效应和局部平均响应函数。识别策略利用一个充分统计量来控制固定效应，并采用一个控制变量来处理随机冲击。在这两个控制条件下，回归元中的剩余变异仅由外生工具变量驱动，因此可用于识别感兴趣参数。构造性识别分析导出了三步级数估计量，我为其建立了收敛速率和渐近正态性。为说明该方法，我估计了中国制造业企业的异质性柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，发现企业间产出弹性存在显著差异，且这些差异可与企业特征相关联。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Identification and estimation in a time-varying endogenous random coefficient panel data model
title_zh: 时变内生随机系数面板数据模型的识别与估计

abstract: We study the labor market effects of permanent 30-64% reductions in unemployment insurance benefits available in seven states. Leveraging linked firm-establishment data, we find that establishments based in reform states experience employment increases that are 0.8-1.3% larger than those of the same firm's establishments in other states. Using a similar multi-state firm design, starting salaries are 1.2-5.5% lower in reform states and posted salaries for the same job fall by 3.2-3.5%. The negative co-movement of employment and wages after the reform suggests a labor supply shock, and mitigates against confounding changes in labor demand driving the results. Our findings are consistent with workers lowering their reservation wages as outside options fall, and employers taking advantage of this by offering lower wages and increasing employment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了七个州将失业保险金永久性削减30%-64%对劳动力市场的影响。利用关联的企业-机构数据，我们发现，位于改革州的机构，其就业增长比同一企业在其他州的机构高出0.8-1.3%。采用类似的多州企业设计，改革州的起薪降低了1.2-5.5%，同一职位的公布薪资下降了3.2-3.5%。改革后就业与工资的负向联动表明存在劳动力供给冲击，并排除了劳动力需求变化作为驱动结果的混淆因素。我们的发现与以下结论一致：随着外部选择减少，工人降低保留工资，雇主借此提供更低工资并增加就业。
title: Unemployment Insurance, Starting Salaries, and Jobs: Evidence from Multi-state Firms
title_zh: 失业保险、起薪与就业：来自多州企业的证据

abstract: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide. To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每个企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们对可行的广告内容不施加任何结构性限制，因此每个企业可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们全面刻画了均衡广告策略的特征，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在的一些充分条件。研究表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能会减少社会剩余，并对消费者造成损害。
title: Competitive Advertising and Pricing
title_zh: 竞争性广告与定价

abstract: Blended finance—the use of public and philanthropic funding to crowd in private capital—has emerged as a potential tool for financing sustainable development. Yet little is known about the design of blended finance contracts. We develop a conceptual framework in which development finance institutions (DFIs) allocate concessional capital across projects to maximize societal impact while crowding in private investors. Our framework highlights a trade-off between sustainability impact and the amount of concessionality required to make projects commercially viable and characterizes how DFIs optimally combine different instruments, including concessional debt, junior equity tranches, and risk management facilities. We then provide empirical evidence on blended finance using deal-level data from a major DFI. Consistent with our conceptual framework, projects with higher anticipated sustainability impact receive greater concessionality. Moreover, concessionality is higher in countries with greater political risk and information asymmetries, and these projects are more likely to include risk management provisions. Our findings provide new evidence on how DFIs deploy catalytic capital to mobilize private investment in sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 混合融资——利用公共和慈善资金撬动私人资本——已成为资助可持续发展的一种潜在工具。然而，关于混合融资合约的设计知之甚少。我们构建了一个概念框架，在此框架中，开发金融机构（DFIs）在项目间分配优惠资本，以最大化社会影响，同时吸引私人投资者。我们的框架揭示了可持续影响与使项目商业可行所需优惠程度之间的权衡，并刻画了DFIs如何最优地组合不同工具，包括优惠债务、次级股权层级和风险管理设施。随后，我们利用一家主要DFI的交易级数据，提供了关于混合融资的实证证据。与我们的概念框架一致，预期可持续影响更高的项目获得了更大的优惠性。此外，在政治风险和信息不对称程度较高的国家，优惠性更高，且这些项目更可能包含风险管理条款。我们的发现为DFIs如何部署催化资本以动员私人投资于可持续发展提供了新的证据。
title: Blended finance
title_zh: 混合融资

abstract: We study the relative impact of custodial and non-custodial sentences on later crime and labor-market outcomes in Denmark, a country where detention conditions are particularly good. To do so, we take advantage of a large-scale reform of the Danish legislation implemented in 2000, whereby incarceration was replaced by a non-custodial sentence for most drunk-driving crimes, which represented a quarter of all custodial sentences passed in 1999. Our first key finding is that stakeholders anticipated the consequences of the reform and that wealthier offenders managed to postpone their trial until after the reform came into force to avoid prison. To measure the relative impact of incarceration, we therefore use a novel instrumental variable approach exploiting quasi-exogenous variation in the probability of being tried after the reform, and therefore incarcerated, based on offenders’ crime date. We follow sampled individuals over a 15-year period and find that incarcerated offenders commit more crimes and have weaker ties to the labor market after release. Additionally, first-time offenders are more negatively affected than repeat offenders.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了丹麦监禁刑与非监禁刑对后续犯罪及劳动力市场结果的相对影响，该国拘留条件尤为优越。为此，我们利用了2000年实施的一项大规模丹麦立法改革，该改革将大多数酒驾犯罪中的监禁刑替换为非监禁刑，而此类犯罪在1999年占所有监禁刑判决的四分之一。我们的首要关键发现是，利益相关者预见到了改革的后果，较富裕的罪犯设法将审判推迟至改革生效之后，以避免入狱。为衡量监禁的相对影响，我们因此采用了一种新颖的工具变量方法，利用基于罪犯犯罪日期的改革后受审概率的准外生变异，从而推断入狱概率。我们对抽样个体进行了15年的追踪，发现入狱罪犯在释放后犯罪更多，且与劳动力市场的联系更为薄弱。此外，初犯者比惯犯受到更为不利的影响。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Custodial versus non-custodial sentences: Long-run evidence from an anticipated reform
title_zh: 监管刑与非监管刑：基于一项预期改革的长期证据
